name: EgoSafetyBench
summary: Evaluates vision-language models as streaming runtime safety monitors on egocentric video from a humanoid viewpoint, including false alarms and misleading in-scene text.
numbers: 1,200 scenarios at 0.5 s granularity; 800 situational, 400 visual-channel

why.cog: Streaming judgement with misleading text and benign look-alikes.
